lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to camp by the sea near Pi-hahiroth, and says He will harden Pharaoh's heart.
Pharaoh takes 600 of his best chariots and chases Israel, catching them camped by the sea.
The cloud moves behind Israel, and the LORD drives the sea back all night with a strong south wind.
At daybreak the sea returns and covers the chariots and horsemen, and not one of them survives.
Miriam, Moses's sister, takes a tambourine, and all the women follow her with tambourines and dancing.
